  "rationale": "Required approvals must remain auditable across handoffs. Reported status conflicts and unclear ownership leave actors unsure who must act, while retries can duplicate a request. Inspection established only `state=blocked`; its cause remains unresolved. The redesign connects each confirmed submission to one request ID, assigns authority by fact, and keeps the sender accountable until the recipient accepts. Concrete verification scenarios cover all five actors, duplicate submissions, interrupted work, accessible recovery, billing uncertainty, cancellation, privacy, and unrelated records. Policy details and billing guarantees remain open before adoption. The response describes the checks as planned. Execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
